description: This file contains utility functions for evaluating object detection models, including computing average precision, gathering detections and annotations, and evaluating model performance on a dataset. It references external modules for overlap computation and visualization, and defines functions for processing detection results and calculating metrics like mAP.

methods.name: _compute_ap
methods.description: Calculates the average precision given recall and precision curves.

methods.name: _get_detections
methods.description: Generates detection results from the model for each image in the dataset.

methods.name: _get_annotations
methods.description: Retrieves ground truth annotations for each image in the dataset.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Main function to evaluate a dataset with a model, returning per-class mAP scores and average inference time.
